name: tiktok-scraper
title: TikTok Scraper
description: Scrape TikTok search results, hashtags, and profiles using session cookies with network interception. Captures 100+ items per query via scroll pagination. Supports a clockworks/tiktok-scraper-compatible input/output mode (profiles/searchQueries/hashtags/resultsPerPage/proxyCountryCode/downloadSubtitlesOptions in, outputSchema:'clockworks' out) for drop-in replacement use.
